focus: City of Atlanta (Midtown, Home Park, West Midtown, Riverside, Peachtree Hills, Buckhead, Chastain Park, Summerhill, and Southwest Atlanta), plus mobile notaries who travel across metro Atlanta
intro: Bank branches in Atlanta usually stop notarizing by late afternoon. This first Atlanta page lists six mobile notaries whose own websites publish 24/7, evening, weekend, or hospital and jail service in metro Atlanta, plus eleven UPS Store locations inside the city whose official pages post notary hours until at least 7:00 PM on weekdays — one Midtown store until 9:00 PM — most of them open Sundays too. It is not a complete inventory; suburbs such as Decatur, Marietta, Sandy Springs, and Dunwoody are covered only through the mobile services. Every hour, fee, and service flag comes from the business’s own page and is dated when we last checked it. If we could not verify a detail, we left it out. Call or text to confirm before you go or book.

listings.name: Atlanta 24/7 Mobile Notary

hours.notes: The homepage says the service is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for mobile notary and fingerprinting, and to call for an immediate response or to schedule.

listings.visitNotes: The homepage says it travels anywhere in metro Atlanta, including hospitals, jails, private residences, workplaces, restaurants, airports, and hotels, and can print documents or provide witnesses for an extra fee. The page says it does not notarize real estate documents. Remote online notarization is not mentioned.
listings.feeNotes: No fees published on the homepage we checked; the page says to call for a quote.

listings.name: Atlanta 24 Hour Notary
listings.area: Metro Atlanta: Fulton, DeKalb, Cobb, Gwinnett, Clayton, Henry, Rockdale, and Douglas counties (mobile)

hours.notes: The homepage says it answers calls 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including nights, weekends, and holidays, and that most visits inside I-285 can be met within about an hour depending on traffic and availability. It is a mobile service, not a walk-in office.

listings.visitNotes: The homepage lists home, office, hospital, and jail visits, plus nursing-home and hospice signings; it can provide hospital witnesses if requested in advance. Remote online notarization is not mentioned.
listings.feeNotes: As listed on 2026-11-22: standard mobile visit inside I-285 $50 (up to 2 notarizations, additional signatures $10 each); outside the perimeter $75–$125 by distance; +$25 for appointments between 9 PM and 6 AM and on Sundays and holidays; hospital, jail, or nursing-home signing $75+; witness for a hospital signing $50 each.

listings.name: Traveling Notary Atlanta

hours.notes: The site footer says 7 days a week, 7 AM–11 PM, with same-day and 24-hour service available. The services page says hospital visits are available evenings, weekends, and overnight when needed.

listings.visitNotes: The site lists hospital bedside visits (it names Piedmont, Grady, Emory, and Northside, among others) and jail visits at the Fulton County and DeKalb County jails, following each facility’s rules. Remote online notarization is not mentioned.
listings.feeNotes: No fees published on the pages we checked.

listings.name: Atlanta’s Public Notary
listings.area: North Atlanta (Roswell, Sandy Springs, Alpharetta, Buckhead, Dunwoody, Brookhaven) and 12 metro counties for added mileage (mobile)

hours.notes: The homepage says it is open 7 days and offers same-day, early-morning, evening, and weekend appointments. Specific hours are not published. Texts are welcome.

listings.visitNotes: The homepage lists home, office, hospital, rehab, assisted-living, and senior-community visits; jail visits are available by request and depend on facility rules. Remote online notarization is not mentioned.
listings.feeNotes: As listed on 2026-11-22: mobile appointments from $20 within a 5-mile radius of the primary North Atlanta area, including one notarized signature. Extra documents, signers, mileage outside the primary area, and after-hours or rush appointments cost more; the page says a full quote is given before travel.

listings.name: Anytime Anywhere Mobile Notary Services

hours.notes: The homepage says same-day, evening, weekend, after-hours, and holiday appointments may be available. The pricing page lists evening appointments (5 PM and later) and weekend appointments. Specific hours are not published.

listings.visitNotes: The site lists visits to homes, offices, hospitals, rehabilitation centers, hospice locations, nursing homes, and assisted-living communities. Jail visits and remote online notarization are not mentioned. Text to book.
listings.feeNotes: As listed on 2026-11-22: standard mobile appointment from $65; evening (5 PM and later) from $85; weekend from $95; hospital and senior-facility appointments from $125. Georgia notarial act fee $2 per act, charged separately.

listings.name: Sign & Go Mobile Notary
listings.area: Cobb County and the northern Atlanta metro, including Buckhead, Midtown, Sandy Springs, and Vinings (mobile)

hours.notes: The homepage lists weekday evenings 5–8 PM and weekends 9 AM–7 PM. Overnight, holiday, and emergency requests are considered case by case for an extra fee.

listings.visitNotes: The homepage lists home, office, hospital, hospice, and assisted-living appointments, and a facility access fee for hospitals and jails. It says all appointments are in person; it does not offer remote online notarization.
listings.feeNotes: As listed on 2026-11-22: Georgia notarial act $2 per signature; travel fee by county ($55 Fulton, $50 Cobb, $65 DeKalb); after-hours or weekend dispatch fee $20; hospital, hospice, or assisted-living appointment $35; $25 facility access fee at hospitals and jails.
